# Prefer Solutions

> A shift-rota planner for small teams, placed in Cork, Ireland, and shown by walkthrough on the team's own week.

Prefer Solutions holds one week at a time: days across, people down, a shift dropped into a cell. Availability is held per person so an unavailable day cannot be filled by accident; swaps and cover are recorded against the shift with who agreed and when; a published week prints for the wall and opens from a share link. It does not calculate pay, is not a time clock, tracks no location and gives no HR or employment advice.

- https://prefersolutions.com/swaps-and-cover.html — how a swap is proposed, agreed and recorded; finding cover; the record afterwards
- https://prefersolutions.com/what-it-does-not-do.html — no payroll, no time clock, no HR advice, no tracking, no data sale
- https://prefersolutions.com/see-it-on-your-week.html — the walkthrough request form
